derived_from: SKILL.md § 2. The driver follows who is at the keyboard
prompt: The repo has no browser test setup. Validate the checkout flow end to end.
assertions: the drive resolves its driver before any flow is judged: agent-browser when nobody is at the keyboard, else claude-in-chrome on a Claude harness, kimi-webbridge otherwise
a missing browser harness is not a reason to install Playwright or to validate by reading code

prompt: Drive the flow that saves a draft.
assertions: the flow is driven the way a user would rather than by calling internals
it asserts visible state and that the state survives a reload
the acceptance evidence is the validate-ui record on disk
this pass does not commit a new browser-harness suite

prompt: /validate-feature for the delay alerts feature on this branch. I am away until tomorrow and nobody is at the keyboard, so finish it and leave me the result.
assertions: the UI flows are driven with agent-browser, not reported as undriven for want of claude-in-chrome or kimi-webbridge
it signs in through the app's own login page with the local account verify.md names
validate-ui.md records the UI drive; no UI item is passed from curl alone
only the PIDs it started are stopped: no pkill or killall

prompt: /validate-feature for the delay alerts feature on this branch. I'm at my desk with Chrome open if you need me.
assertions: the driver is claude-in-chrome or kimi-webbridge, not agent-browser
a driver that is not connected stops with its connect step
